title: Reverse the operations that turn token IDs into loss
description: A quick reference for the embedding, activation, projection, and loss gradients used here.

terms.definition: A trainable matrix containing one feature row per vocabulary item.
Selecting table rows by integer token identifiers during the forward pass.
A discrete vocabulary index that selects one embedding-table row.
A token identifier appearing multiple times and sharing one parameter row.
Returning occurrence gradients by adding them into their selected table rows.
A reverse matrix-product rule producing gradients for both matrix operands.
A smooth activation multiplying each input by its sigmoid value.
Logarithms of class probabilities computed through a stable normalization.
Average negative log-likelihood across target classes selected by integer indices.
The loss sensitivity assigned to every target and competing logit.
